text: 1/5 stars - McDonald's, you're better than this! I'm not expecting gourmet food, but I do expect my order to be right. Unfortunately, the DoorDash/UberEats team handling online orders needs some serious improvement. Orders get messed up (wrong sauces, missing items, etc.), refunds are nonexistent, and it feels like they're playing a game of "who can screw the customer the most." Today, I had to step in and fix the mess myself. If they can't get it together, maybe it's time for a change in management. Fix the online ordering process, McDonald's! Because I ordered an apple pie she puts a pumpkin pie in my bag I’m wrong if I go inside and hurt her right ? I see why they be unaliving them people stop aging with people hard earned money fr pack sauces for nuggets and if u don’t have the right pie refund me my money simple
author: Sparkle Rivera

text: I used my 15000 for 50 dollsr discount on my Booking.com vacation.  When I tried to apply the code it said that the code is not valid. I contact the Booking.com and they said that it's because I have account in Booking.com and that the coupon of 50 dollars can not be applied to the deal because the rate for the hotel is already within Genius loyalty programm and that coupon doesn't work with it. That was disappointing because these terms where not mentioned anywhere on McDonald's or Booking.com.  I'm very upset know that I have lost my 15000 point at McDonald's and no discount on my hotel. Please return my 15000points to my McDonald's account!

text: As someone who’s gone to this mcdonald’s my whole life, I’m currently going through the effects of food poisoning because of this mcdonald. I ordered a triple cheeseburger, fries, and 10 piece for me and my family to share. We all woke up sick and throwing up. This mcdonald’s has gone extremely down in quality. Their nuggets had hard pieces, the employees are rude and dismissive. The wait lines are incredibly long and you have to literally chase down someone to come to the register to take your order.  Don’t come here.
